title: Ordering: The modern era
short: Which came first? 11 events from The modern era.
trouble: Judging 'which came first' by how famous something is.

blocks.html: Ordering is the skill behind every timeline: not dates by heart, but before and after. This drill pairs events from The modern era and asks which came first.
Tip: anchor on one event you are sure of, then place the other against it.
You can browse every event in the Timeline dataset.
